Hey Linda,

Just wanted to drop you a quick note to say hi and share something nice I noticed in our neighborhood. On my walk back from the grocery store, I saw your dog, Max, at the little park down the street. He looked so happy and playful running around with all the other dogs! It's great to see he's getting some exercise and having fun. I'm sure that brings a smile to your face too. Take care and talk to you soon!
